The Department of Chemistry offers the following programs and degrees:
M.Phil (2-year)
Ph.D. (3-year)
Ph. D. (4-year)
Admission Requirements for Dept of Chemistry
A B. Sc. degree with IIA honours or above from this University or an equivalent qualification from a comparable institution.
An M. Phil. (Research) degree from this University or an equivalent qualification from a comparable institution.
A B. Sc. degree with 1st Honours from this University or an equivalent qualification from a comparable institution.
Program
Research; ethics course, compulsory and elective postgraduate courses
Research; ethics course, safety course and other postgraduate courses as stipulated by Department/Supervisor
Research, ethics course, compulsory and elective postgraduate courses
Remarks
Students accepted to read for the M. Phil. can apply to transfer to the 4-year Ph. D. program after successfully completing the first year of studies
--
--
In addition, if your B. Sc. is obtained from a university or an institution outside Hong Kong where the language of teaching and/or examination is not English, you will also need to fulfill an English requirement.
Departmental Requirements
For MPhil students: Participation in and presentation at research seminars and/or guided study.
For PhD students: Participation in and presentation at seminars; any other specific departmental requirements.
